commands:
nft add table inet f2b-table
nft -- add chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain \{ type filter hook input priority -1 \; \}
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo '2812' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo '2812' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi

{ nft flush set inet f2b-table <addr_set> 2> /dev/null; } || {
{ nft -a list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | sed -nE 's/.*@<addr_set>\s+.*\s+\#\s*(handle\s+[0-9]+)$/\1/p'; } | while read -r hdl; do
nft delete rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $hdl; done
nft delete set inet f2b-table <addr_set>
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo '2812' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo '2812' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi
}
nft list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | grep -q '@<addr_set>[ \t]'

printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] monit: started on <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <root@<fq-hostname>>
To: root@localhost\n
Hi,\n
The jail monit has been started successfully.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "root@<fq-hostname>" "root@localhost"

printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] monit: stopped on <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <root@<fq-hostname>>
To: root@localhost\n
Hi,\n
The jail monit has been stopped.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "root@<fq-hostname>" "root@localhost"

printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] monit: banned <ip> from <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <root@<fq-hostname>>
To: root@localhost\n
Hi,\n
The IP <ip> has just been banned by Fail2Ban after
<failures> attempts against monit.\n\n
Here is more information about <ip> :\n
`whois <ip> || echo "missing whois program"`\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "root@<fq-hostname>" "root@localhost"

files.jail.local:
[DEFAULT]
bantime = 2h
[monit]
enabled = true
bantime = 10m
action = %(action_mw)s
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=ddos]

stderr: fail2ban.jailreader: WARNING Have not found any log file for 'monit' jail.
